title: SEO Meta: Titles, Descriptions and Social Sharing Cards | Orchard Core
description:
Search engines and social networks read a few values from every page: its title, a description, the address that identifies it, and the pictures that go with a shared link. Orchard Core can set these values for the whole site and for each page.

The SEO module keeps them in two places: Social Meta Settings holds defaults for the whole site, and the SeoMeta part holds the values of a single page. This video enables the module, sets the site-wide defaults, attaches the part to a content type, and fills in the SEO tab of a page.

In this video:
• Two places for the values
• Enable the module
• Site-wide defaults in Social Meta Settings
• Add the SeoMeta part to a content type
• Edit the SEO tab of a page
• Where each value comes from
